out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at handwashing sink NEAR DISHWASHING MACHINE AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC ADDED PAPER TOWELS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE HANDWASHING SINKS ARE ALWAYS PROPERLY SUPPLIED.

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: OBSERVED HANDWASHING SINK NEAR DISHWASHING MACHINE AREA WITH A JUG OF SOAP IN THE SINK BASIN.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PIC REMOVED SOAP DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE HANDWASHING SINKS ARE ALWAYS ACCESSIBLE AND ONLY USED FOR HANDWASHING. MADRAS CHOPSTICKS (Inspection Date: 06/08/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees. OBSERVED HANDWASHING SINK AT THE COOK-LINE WITHOUT SIGNAGE.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. EHS WILL EMAIL PIC A COPY OF HANDWASHING SIGNAGE.

violations.title: Food from Approved Source
violations.observation: OBSERVED ROSE WATER IN THE ESTABLISHMENT LABELED FOR RELIGIOUS PURPOSES ONLY.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be obtained from sources that comply with the Law. PIC REMOVED ROSE WATER FROM THE ESTABLISHMENT. PIC UNDERSTANDS ALL FOOD MUST COME FROM AN APPROVED SOURCE. PLEASE PROVIDE EHS WITH ROSE WATER OPTIONS IN THE FUTURE PRIOR TO PURCHASING.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED COOKED CHICKEN AT 46-48F, MUTTON AT 46-52F, AND DICED TOMATOES AT 55F IN THE TWO DOOR PREP-TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC MOVED FOOD ITEMS TO THE WALK-IN COOLER DURING INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS FOOD ITEMS SHOULD NOT BE STORED ON TOP OF OTHER FOODS IN THE PREP-TOP PORTIONS OF COOLERS; CONTAINERS NEED TO BE FULLY INSIDE THE PREP TOP. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION.

out_items.name: Compliance with variance, specialized process, HACCP

violations.title: Non-Commercial Juice, Warning Label Not Pasteurized
violations.observation: Untreated juice packaged in the food establishment is not labeled with a proper warning statement. OBSERVED BOTTLED MANGO LASSI AND ROSE JUICE WITHOUT A WARNING LABEL MADE AT THE ESTABLISHMENT.
violations.corrective_action: Juice packaged in a food establishment, if not treated to attain a 5-log reduction of the most resistant microorganism of public health significance, shall be labeled with a warning notice that states 'WARNING: This product has not been pasteurized and, therefore, may contain harmful bacteria that can cause serious illness in children, the elderly, and persons with weakened immune systems'. PIC AGREED TO DISCONTINUE BOTTLING JUICES AT THE ESTABLISHMENT. BOTTLES DRINKS ONSITE AT TIME OF INSPECTION WERE DISCARDED OF. PLEASE CONTACT THE EHS REGARDING LABELING IN THE FUTURE IF THE ESTABLISHMENT WISHES TO BOTTLE DRINKS AGAIN IN THE FUTURE.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equip/Utensils, Durable under Normal Use
violations.observation: The following equipment is not designed and constructed to be durable: OBSERVED IKEA BRAND STORAGE CONTAINERS BEING USED TO STORE DRY FOODS SUCH AS SUGAR AND FLOUR.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment and utensils shall be designed and constructed to be durable and to retain their characteristic qualities under normal use conditions. PLEASE REMOVED STORAGE CONTAINERS AS SOON AS POSSIBLE AND REPLACE WITH NSF-APPROVED STORAGE CONTAINERS.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER (CFM) AT START OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM ARRIVED DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE A CFM IS ON SITE DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION INCLUDING DURING PREPARATION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: OBSERVED HOT WATER TEMPERATURE AT HANDWASH SINKS IN RESTROOM AND OPPOSITE 3 COMPARTMENT SINK AT 86F.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. PLEASE ENSURE WATER HEATER IS SERVICED IF NECESSARY TO PROVIDE WATER AT 100F AT HANDWASH SINKS BEFORE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: RAW MARINATED CHICKEN AND RAW SHELLED EGGS ABOVE COOKED LENTILS, ONION SAUCE AND CHILI SOUP IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC RELOCATED RAW FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: OBSERVED SEVERAL FOODS IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR PREPARED FOR MORE THAN 24 HOURS WITHOUT APPROPRIATE DATE MARKING: BIRYANI RICE, LENTILS SOUP, CURRY CHICKEN, ONION SOUP, ETC.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EMPLOYEES STARTED APPLY DATE MARKED LABELS DURING INSPECTION. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: Time as a Public Health Control, Written Procedures
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide written procedures for the use of time as a public health control with the following time/temperature control for safety food item(s): RICE PUDDING AT 105F ON COUNTER TOP AND UNSALTED BUTTER AT 71F NEAR COOK LINE. EMPLOYEE INDICATED 4 HOUR TIME WAS BEING USED. NO DOCUMENTATION OBSERVED.
violations.corrective_action: If time only is used as a public health control for a working supply of time/temperature control for safety food before cooking or for ready to eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that is displayed or held for service for immediate consumption, written procedures shall be prepared in advance and maintained in the food establishment and made available to the regulatory authority upon request. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EMPLOYEE APPLIED 4 HOUR PERIOD LABELS TO FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold hot equipment: 2 DRAWER PREP TOP UNIT.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC PLACED UNIT THERMOMETER IN PREP TOP DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: WORKING CONTAINERS OF SALT, SUGAR, MSG AND SPICES NEAR COOK LINE.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EMPLOYEE APPLIED TEMPORARY LABELS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wipings Clothes Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counters near cookline and prep top counters.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC REMOVED WET WIPING CLOTHS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE SANITIZER BUCKETS WITH SANITIZER OF APPROPRIATE CONCENTRATIONS ARE SET UP TO STORE WET WIPING CLOTHS. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers GARLIC CONTAINERS were observed reused for the storage of SPICES, HERBS AND OTHER FOOD ITEMS.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE ENSURE FOODS ARE REMOVED FROM MANUFACTURER CONTAINERS AND ONLY NSF FOOD SAFE CONTAINERS ARE USED FOR FOOD STORAGE. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: The temperature of water at 3 compartment sink was observed at maximum 92F.
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution for manual warewashing machine must be no less than 110F or the temperature specified on the cleaning agent manufacturer's label instructions. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE ENSURE WATER HEATER IS SERVICED TO PROVIDE HOT WATER AT MINIMUM TEMPERATURE OF 110F AT 3 COMPARTMENT SINK. MADRAS CHOPSTICKS (Inspection Date: 01/27/2025) Page 2 of 4

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Protective Shielding on Light Bulbs
violations.observation: Observed that the end caps are missing from the protective light covering of fluorescent light fixtures in the BACK KITCHEN STORAGE AREA OVER FREEZER.
violations.corrective_action: Provide end caps to completely enclose the light bulb. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE REPAIR BEFORE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.
